born.name: James Wolfe
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of the Plains of Abraham, on learning that the French forces were fleeing
born.last_words: Go, one of you, to Colonel Burton; tell him to march Webb's regiment down to Charles River, to cut off their retreat from the bridge. Now, God be praised, I will die in peace!
